paite: Huan gentehna thu in akiang uah agen a, "Mi kuahiam in grephuan abawl a, akim huang in a-um a, grep sukna ding khuk atou a, insang alam a, loukhou mite kiang ah khohloh ding in apia a, gamdang ah apaisanta hi.
heading: Grephuan Gentehna Thu / (Mat 21.33-46; Luk 20.9-19)

paite: Agah loh hun in atansik amau kiang a kipan la ding in lou khohloh mite kiang ah sikha khat asawl hi.
Huai mi ana man ua, avua ua, khutvuak in apaisak uhi.
Huan sikha dang akiang uah asawl nawn a; huai mi leng alu ana hihliam ua, zumhuaipi in ana bawl uhi.
Huan sikha dang asawl nawn zel a; huai mi ana that ua, sikha dang tampi leng, khenkhat ana vua ua, khenkhat ana that uhi.
Huan sawl ding khat, atapa deihtak kia anei lai hi; 'Ka tapa zaw ana zahtak ding uh' chi in amah ananungpen in akiang uah asawl hi.
Himahleh huai lou khohloh mite'n, 'hiai mi gouluah dingpa ahi; i that ding uh aw; huchi in agouluah ding ei a ahi mai ding,' akichi uhi.
Huchi in amah aman ua, that in, grephuan a pan alawnkhia uhi.
Huaiziak in grephuan neipa'n bangchi in ahon hih dia? Lou khohloh mite ahon hihmangthang dia; grephuan midangte ape ding hi.
Hiai Laisiangthou na sim kei ua hia? 'Inn lam mite' suang deih louhpen, huai mahmah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita hi.
Huai Toupa hih ahi, i mitmuh un alamdang hi, chih,' " achi hi.
Huan amah mat atum ua; himahleh huai gentehna thu amau dem a agen ahi chih atheih ziak un, mipite alau uhi. Huchi in amah anusia ua, apaimangta uhi.
Huan athugen a mat ahihtheihna ding in Pharisaite leh Herod pawl a mi kuate hiam akiang ah asawl uhi.
heading: Leiman Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.15-22; Luk 20.20-26)

paite: Huchi in amau ahong tun un akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, midiktat na hi a, deihsak tuam kuamah na nei kei chih ka thei uh, kuamah khentuam nei lou in, chihtak ngial in Pathian lam thu na hilh zel hi; Kaisar kiang a leiman liau asiang hia siang lou?
Pe ding ka hi uhia, pe lou ding?" achi uhi. Ama'n alepchiahdan uh thei in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon ze-et na hi ua? Makhai hon tawi un, ka en ding," achi hi.
Ahon tawi ua, ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kua lim leh kua min ahia?" achi hi.
Amau, "Kaisar a," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah peta unla," achi hi. Huchi in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huan Saddukai, thohnawnna a-om kei chite, akiang ah ahong ua,
heading: Thohnawnna Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.23-33; Luk 20.27-40)

paite: akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, kuapeuh a-unaupa'n ta nei lou in azi sihsan taleh a-unaupa'n azi luah in a-unaupa a ding in chi asuahsak ding chi in ahon gelhsak hi.
Ahi, sal sagih a-om ua; a-upapen in zi anei a, chi suah lou in asi hi.
Huan anihna in aluah a, chi suah lou in asi nawn zel a; athumna in huchi mah bang in.
Huchi in sal sagihte chi suah lou in asita ua, atawpna ah numei leng asita hi.
Thohnawn hun in akua pen zi ahi dia le? Sagihte'n zi in anei chiat ngal ua," chi in adong uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai ziak hilou hia, na theihkhelh nak uh, Laisiangthou leh Pathian thilhihtheihna na theih louh ziak un?
Misi lak a pan athohnawn hun un zi leh pasal a kinei lou in, van angelte bang ahi zawta ding uh ahi.
Huan misite kaihthoh a a-om ding thu lah Mosi laibu a loubukh kuang thu a Pathian in, 'Kei Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ka hi, chi a, amah ahoupihdan na sim kei ua hia?'
Amah misi Pathian ahi kei a, mihing Pathian ahi zaw; na theikhial tel uh," achi hi.
Huan laigelhmite lak a mi khat ahong a, akisel uh ana ngaikhia a, Jesu'n amaute thutak in adawng chih athei a, akiang ah, "Thupiak tengteng ah koi ahia thupipen?" chi in adong hi.
heading: Thupiak Thupipen Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.34-40; Luk 10.25-28)

paite: Jesu'n, "Athupipen hiai ahi; Israel aw, ngai dih uh, Toupa i Pathian uh Toupa khat kia ahi;
'Toupa na Pathian na lungtang tengteng in, na kha tengteng in, na lungsim tengteng in leh na hatna tengteng in na it ding ahi,' chih.
Azom hiai ahi, 'Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding,' chih. Hiaite sang a thupiak thupizaw a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
Laigelhmi'n akiang ah, "Hina ngei e, Sinsakpa amah zaw khat kia ahi a, amah lou zaw kuamah dang a-om kei,
amah lungtang tengteng, theihsiamna tengteng, hatna tengteng a it a, eimah i ki-it bang a vengte it halmang thilpiak leh kithoihna tengteng sang in ahoihzaw petmah chih, na gen dik ngei," achi hi.
Piltak in adawng chih Jesu'n atheih in akiang ah, "Pathian lalgam na gamlat kei hi," achi a, huai nungsiah kuamah in thu adong ngamta kei uhi.
Huan tempul a Jesu'n thu ahilh lai in, amau ahoupih a, "Khrist David tapa ahi chih laigelhmite'n bangchidan a gen uh ahia?
heading: Messia Tanchin Dotna / (Mat 22.41-46; Luk 21.5-6)

paite: David ngei in, Kha Siangthou in, Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, 'Na melmate na khepek ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, achi,' achi hi.
"David ngei in amah Toupa, achi ngal a, koi a kipan in ahia amah atapa ahih?" achi hi. Huan mivantang in kipaktak in athu angaikhia uhi.
Huan athuhilhna ah, "Lai-gelhmite lak ah pilvang un; amau puanaktual silh a vak a-ut ua, dawr munte ah mite chibai abuk ua,
heading: Laigelhmite Vauna / (Mat 23.1-36; Luk 20.45-47)

paite: sinagog ah tutphah hoihpen leh ankuangluina a mun hoihpen adeihtuam nak uh;
meithai inn anegai ua, kilimbawl in sawt pipi athum uh; huaite'n siam louh tanna lianzaw atang ding uh," achi hi.
Huan sumkholna zawn ah atu a; sumkholna a mipi sumkhiakdan a-en a; mihau tampitak in tampipi akhia uhi.
heading: Meithai Thilpiak / (Luk 21.1-4)

paite: Meithai zawngtak ahong pai a, dal dangka muza nih akhia a, huai tuh paihsa khat hu ahi.
Jesu'n anungzuite asam a, akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, sumkholna a khe tengteng lak ah hiai meithai zawngtak in akhe tampen hi.
Hiaite tengteng in aneihlet uh akhia ua; ama'n zaw adeihthoh laitak, aneihsun, ahinna ding tengteng akhe vek ahi," achi hi.
